title: An evaluation of LLMs and Google Translate for translation of selected Indian languages via sentiment and semantic analyses
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and benchmarks the performance of LLMs on translating religious and philosophical texts, most notably the Bhagavad Gita. It discusses the preservation of theological terms, sentiment in sacred contexts, and cultural/religious sensitivities, such as dietary ethics in Hinduism (e.g., the term 'tamasik').
